units.source_text: 纪伊守说：“太匆促了。”心中着急。

en.t: The Governor of Kii said, "This is far too sudden," and felt anxious at heart.
But everyone paid him no attention.

units.source_text: 他只得把正殿东面的房间收拾干净，铺陈了相应的设备，供公子暂住。

en.t: He had no choice but to clean and prepare the room east of the main hall, arrange suitable furnishings, and let the young lord stay there for the time being.

units.source_text: 这里的池塘景色颇有趣致，四周围着柴垣，有田家风味，庭中花木也应有尽有。

en.t: The pond scenery here had considerable charm; brushwood fences surrounded it on every side, giving it a rustic air, and the garden had every kind of flower and tree one could want.

units.source_text: 水风凉爽，处处虫声悠扬，流萤乱飞，好一片良宵美景！

en.t: The breeze from the water was cool, insects sang lingeringly everywhere, and drifting fireflies flew about in confusion: what a beautiful scene on this fine night!

units.source_text: 随从们都在廊下泉水旁边坐地，相与饮酒。

en.t: The attendants all sat on the ground beside the spring under the veranda and drank together.

units.source_text: 主人纪伊守则匆忙奔走，张罗肴馔。

en.t: Their host, the Governor of Kii, hurried about busily arranging food and drink.

units.source_text: 源氏公子从容眺望四周景色，回忆起前日的雨夜品评，

en.t: Prince Genji calmly looked out over the surrounding scenery and recalled the discussion on that rainy night a few days before,

units.source_text: 想道：“左马头所谓中等人家，大概就是指这种人家了。”

en.t: thinking, "This must be the sort of household the Captain of the Left Division of the Inner Palace Guards meant by a middle-ranking family."

units.source_text: 他以前听人说起，纪伊守的后母[\[24\]](#part1331.html#m24)作姑娘时是矜持自重的，

en.t: He had once heard that the Governor of Kii's stepmother[\[24\]](#part1331.html#m24), when she was still a young woman, had been reserved and self-possessed,

units.source_text: 常思一见，便耸耳倾听，但闻西面的房间里有人声：

en.t: and as he had long wished to see her, he pricked up his ears and listened; he heard voices from the room to the west:

units.source_text: 裙声窸窣，语声娇嫩，颇为悦耳。

en.t: skirts rustled softly, and the tender young voices were quite pleasant to hear.

units.source_text: 只为这边有客，故意低声，轻言窃笑，显然是装腔作势的。

en.t: Because there were guests on this side, they deliberately lowered their voices, whispered lightly, and laughed in secret, plainly putting on airs.
